# Studio Monjo

> Hand-bound notebooks made by French maker Jordan Monnet in Seoul, South Korea.

Studio Monjo makes illustrated Robey notebooks, individual pieces, and custom company editions. Jordan folds, sews and checks each notebook himself. Robey (Roby in French, 러비 in Korean) is a small robot discovering the human world.

Robey notebooks have 48 blank 105gsm pages (24 sheets) and removable lined and grid guides. They come in pocket A6 (about 105 × 148 mm) and standard A5 (about 148 × 210 mm). Individual pieces shown on the website are examples; availability is confirmed through the shop or studio.

Every language shows prices for both routes: in Korea through Naver, pocket ₩21,000 and standard ₩32,000; international orders through Instagram, pocket €15 and standard €25. Shipping and final prices are confirmed when ordering. Company editions begin at 20 copies, with Brand and Illustration options. Current details are on the linked pages.

- [Hand-Bound Notebooks & Robey Editions | Studio Monjo (en)](https://studiomonjo.com/en/notebooks/): Explore hand-bound notebooks made by Jordan Monnet in Seoul, from illustrated Robey editions with blank 105gsm pages to one-of-a-kind pieces.
- [Cahiers illustrés Roby et pièces uniques | Studio Monjo (fr)](https://studiomonjo.com/fr/notebooks/): Les cahiers de Jordan Monnet, reliés à la main à Séoul : éditions illustrées de Roby aux pages blanches de 105 g/m², et pièces uniques.
- [러비 그림 노트와 세상에 한 권뿐인 손제본 노트 | Studio Monjo (ko)](https://studiomonjo.com/ko/notebooks/): 몬조단이 서울에서 한 권씩 손으로 만드는 노트. 러비의 여섯 가지 그림 표지, 105gsm 무지 내지와 줄·모눈 가이드, 세상에 한 권뿐인 작품을 살펴보세요.
- [Jordan Monnet, Notebook Maker in Seoul | Studio Monjo (en)](https://studiomonjo.com/en/about/): Meet Jordan Monnet, the French maker behind Studio Monjo in Seoul, and discover why he makes notebooks by hand for writing, drawing and personal stories.
- [Jordan Monnet, créateur de cahiers à Séoul | Studio Monjo (fr)](https://studiomonjo.com/fr/about/): Rencontrez Jordan Monnet, artisan français à Séoul et créateur de Studio Monjo. Son histoire, son goût de l’écriture et ses cahiers fabriqués à la main.
- [몬조단, 서울에서 노트를 만드는 사람 | Studio Monjo (ko)](https://studiomonjo.com/ko/about/): 스튜디오 몬조의 몬조단(Jordan Monnet)은 서울에서 작업하는 프랑스인입니다. 만년필과 손글씨를 좋아하고, 직접 노트를 제본하는 이유와 러비 이야기를 들려드립니다.
- [Custom Company Notebooks, Hand-Bound in Seoul | Studio Monjo (en)](https://studiomonjo.com/en/company-editions/): Custom hand-bound notebooks made in Seoul from 20 copies. Choose your logo or an original Robey illustration, with an opening message for your team or partners.
- [Cahiers d’entreprise personnalisés | Studio Monjo (fr)](https://studiomonjo.com/fr/company-editions/): Des cahiers d’entreprise reliés à la main à Séoul dès 20 exemplaires. Votre logo ou une illustration originale de Roby, avec un message à l’intérieur.
- [기업 맞춤 손제본 노트 · 20권부터 | Studio Monjo (ko)](https://studiomonjo.com/ko/company-editions/): 서울에서 손으로 만드는 기업 맞춤 노트, 20권부터 주문할 수 있습니다. 회사 로고 또는 러비의 오리지널 그림에 제본실과 첫 페이지 메시지를 더합니다.

## Buying and company enquiries

- [Naver shop](https://smartstore.naver.com/studiomonjo): Individual notebook orders for delivery in South Korea.
- [Instagram orders](https://ig.me/m/studio.monjo): Individual customers outside Korea; confirm availability, shipping and payment with the studio.
- [Company enquiry form](https://studiomonjo.com/en/company-editions/#company-brief): Custom company notebooks.
- [Studio Monjo on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/studiomonjo/): Company enquiries and studio updates.
